observations: The earlier upper physical windows were too far left and too high, while reference-painted bright windows partly lay on solid walls. Two clerestory wall sections now contain four observed openings, including one partly visible left opening and one crossing the old bay boundary.

The crossing window required clearing two inferred room partitions at upper-storey height. Their lower footprints and roof-contact pieces were rebuilt as closed solids. Five structural probes find no remaining wall within one meter immediately behind the panes.

Thirty-three new closed solids contain 10208 triangles. The four observed windows use five solid glazing pieces; every piece intersects at least five frame members in the final mesh. All old retained face positions and UVs pass the saved-file checks. Movie and night scene states remain unchanged.

Twelve manually observed corners of the three fully visible upper windows differ from the reconstructed opening corners by at most 0.5184 pixels at 708x1000. The manual uncertainty is 1.5 pixels. This is a local alignment result, not a whole-scene fidelity score.

The initial close oblique render revealed two thin foreground steel rods still painted into the original facade texture, creating duplicate rods after rotation. Their traces were removed in an isolated atlas copy. Exactly 707 source-resolution pixels are inside the additional mask; every old facade pixel outside it is unchanged. The new clerestory also uses a source-resolution atlas with these rods excluded. Hidden colors are interpolated.

The final close oblique render confirms that the duplicate diagonal rod traces have disappeared from the wall, with the actual three-dimensional rods remaining in front. It also makes the still-unrepaired mismatch between arch paintings and underlying arch geometry visible; that row is the next structural target.

Final front, detail, oblique and close oblique renders all come from the saved native SHA in this review. The silhouette and broader courtyard remain intact. The fixed glazing appearance, partial left-window colors, weathering and hidden architecture remain approximate.

Chained v46-v48 Three.js construction, the seven changed facade buckets, new material overrides, two atlas PNGs, and 22 HTTP resources were verified. Browser GPU execution is still unverified; the last actual browser connection attempt failed in v47.
